observation.visible_scene: Close-up of food cooking on a flat, dark, oily griddle. The right and center are filled with neat rows of sliced, browned pork-belly pieces glistening with rendered fat; the left holds a pile of red chili-coated cabbage/kimchi with pale stems and white enoki-like strands. Thin wisps of steam/smoke hover over the surface throughout.
visible_changes: Continuous, drifting wisps of steam/smoke rise above the meat rows, changing shape and position from frame to frame.
The fat and oil on the meat show shifting specular highlights and small bubbling, indicating ongoing sizzling.

A slow camera drift (panning left and tilting up / pulling back slightly) gradually reveals more of the left kimchi pile and the dark upper rim of the grill, while the meat rows shift rightward and downward within the frame.
The food pieces themselves stay fixed in place—no flipping, sliding, or tool contact is visible during the excerpt.
outside_clip_unknowns: The heat source and any earlier placement or later flipping/removal of the meat are not shown.
Whether the excerpt is part of a longer continuous cook or a looped segment cannot be determined from the crop.
uncertain_details: The exact camera motion (pan vs. slight zoom vs. tilt) is hard to disentangle from the moving steam.
Tiny apparent shifts of individual meat cubes may be camera drift or sizzling vibration rather than object movement.
